title: Filmic HDR Lens Flare
description: A fullscreen TSL compositor that derives finite optical ghost families from an HDR emitter, deforms pupil footprints by true field angle, and combines spectral rings, localized bloom, veiling glare, and a calibrated film response.
techniques: spectral pupil ring and source diffraction star
localized multi-scale bloom and veiling glare
filmic density, shoulder, vignette, and grain
